findings.suggested: computadora → máquina in each value (e.g. «Esfuerzo, {effort}, predeterminado de esta máquina»; «Nivel de esta máquina»; «Esta máquina solo inicia conversaciones dentro de tu carpeta personal o de su carpeta temporal.»)
findings.problem: Terminology drift. es renders 'computer' as «máquina» in 27 other mobile values and 61 core values (same namespace: connect_disabled_reason «Conecta una máquina», folders_read_failed, models_read_failed, options.default_model); «computadora» occurs in no other value of either repo — only these 9 new keys, so the picker sheet and the home screen beside it name the same computer two ways.

«Inicio» reads as the Home/Start screen, not the home folder. Core es renders the home folder «carpeta personal» (relay.chrome.session.ended_hint; mobile relay.health.ended_detail); the badge's short form is «Personal».

current.mobile.home.picker.folder_outside: Esta computadora solo inicia conversaciones dentro de tu carpeta de inicio o de su carpeta temporal.

findings.suggested: «… dentro de tu carpeta personal o de su carpeta temporal.» (plus máquina, above)
findings.problem: «carpeta de inicio» appears nowhere else in either repo; «carpeta personal» is the established es term (1 mobile + 5 core values).
